source.author: verg
source.text: Accipite ergo animis atque haec mea figite dicta, quae Phoebo pater omnipotens, mihi Phoebus Apollo praedixit, vobis Furiarum ego maxuma pando.
source.text_original: Accipite ergo animis atque haec mea figite dicta, / quae Phoebo pater omnipotens, mihi Phoebus Apollo / praedixit, vobis Furiarum ego maxuma pando.
source.text_english: Therefore receive these words in your minds and fix them firmly: what almighty Father told me in advance by Phoebus, Phoebus Apollo, I reveal to you, the greatest things of the Furies.

reuse.author: val
reuse.text: astitit et nigro fumantia pocula tabo contigit ipsa gravi Furiarum maxima dextra; illi avide exceptum pateris hausere cruorem.
reuse.text_original: ' — / astitit et nigro fumantia pocula tabo / contigit ipsa gravi Furiarum maxima dextra; / illi avide exceptum pateris hausere cruorem.
reuse.text_english: And she stood there, and with her own heavy right hand, greatest of the Furies, she touched the cups smoking with black gore; they eagerly drank in the blood that had been received in bowls.
